title: MPP endpoint
description: Does a pay-per-call API that speaks MPP (the Payment HTTP authentication scheme) answer, charge what it quotes, follow the scheme, stay safe to call from an agent, and return correct output? Free probes of the unpaid 402 (challenges, a malformed credential) plus a sample of paid calls where SwarmMemo holds a rail for the method, scored by internal/rubric (swarmmemo rubric score). The x402-endpoint rubric's dimensions, weights, gates and grades; only the conformance checks differ. Value (price) is shown beside the score, never inside it.
notes: Draft: the curves and thresholds are calibrated once, after the first 100 subjects, against paid-call failure over the next 14 days (RFC 0015 §10), then frozen as 1.0.0. The UI never compares scores across major versions.

checks.title: Reachable
checks.measure: A TLS connection and an HTTP response within 10 s
checks.validity: Seen from one vantage: a geo-block or a rate limit on that vantage fails it too.

checks.title: Unpaid request answers 402
checks.measure: status == 402 with at least one WWW-Authenticate: Payment challenge; not 5xx, not 200 without payment
checks.validity: Uses the documented example input; a 400 for that input fails it, which may be the documentation's fault.

checks.title: Unpaid latency
checks.measure: Time to the first byte of the 402, in ms, per probe; p95
checks.validity: Network distance from the vantage is included; compare endpoints from one vantage only.

checks.title: Paid call succeeds
checks.measure: 2xx after the payment the challenge asks for
checks.validity: A small paid sample: its uncertainty shows in the band, never hidden.

checks.title: Output valid
checks.measure: Parses and validates against the declared output schema (the service's OpenAPI document, x-payment-info) or the documented example's shape; non-empty; within the declared size
checks.validity: A valid shape is not correct content: R6 checks content where it can.

checks.title: Paid latency
checks.measure: Request with the credential to the last byte, in ms; p95
checks.validity: Includes settlement time, which the server does itself under MPP (no facilitator role in the spec).

checks.title: Challenge parses
checks.measure: At least one WWW-Authenticate: Payment challenge that parses as auth-params (RFC 9110 §11), at most 8 KiB each, every parameter once
checks.validity: Checks the published Payment scheme only (draft-httpauth-payment-01), not whether every client in the wild accepts it.

checks.title: Challenge fields
checks.measure: id, realm, method, intent and request present; method and intent are lowercase tokens; realm names the endpoint's host; header, when present, is Payment-Authorization
checks.validity: Mechanical field checks; an HMAC-bound id is not recomputed (only the server holds its key).

checks.title: Request well formed
checks.measure: request is base64url (no padding) of a JSON object with amount an integer string, currency, and recipient where the method needs one; methodDetails.chainId matches the method (tempo 4217, evm the stated chain; a tempo challenge on another chain fails)
checks.validity: A well-formed request can still quote a wrong price (H1) or name an unreal asset; the asset is checked against a fixed table of stablecoin contracts.

checks.title: Expiry
checks.measure: expires, when present, is an RFC 3339 time in the future, at most 24 hours ahead, at the probe
checks.validity: Read against the lab's clock; skew of a few seconds is tolerated.

checks.title: Problem details on a bad credential
checks.measure: A malformed credential (Authorization: Payment with garbage) gets 402, a fresh challenge and an RFC 9457 application/problem+json body whose type is a https://paymentauth.org/problems/ type
checks.validity: Costs nothing: the credential carries no signature. A server that answers 400 with a problem passes the problem part only.

checks.title: Payment-Receipt
checks.measure: After a paid call, Payment-Receipt is base64url of a JSON object with status success, the challenge's method, a timestamp and a reference that is the settled transaction
checks.validity: Read on chain through a fixed RPC; unmeasured, never failed, while it is down. Needs a rail for the method: Tempo and Stripe challenges stay unmeasured.

checks.title: Price as listed
checks.measure: The challenge's request amount equals the listed price (the service's OpenAPI x-payment-info, the mpp.dev directory, the docs page; the fetch is notary-stamped)
checks.validity: Compares against the listing read at the same time; a stale listing elsewhere is not the endpoint's fault.

checks.title: Price stable
checks.measure: No price change in 30 days; an increase without a revision note fails
checks.validity: A noted price change passes: the rule is surprise, not price.

checks.title: Recipient stable
checks.measure: No change of the request's recipient in 30 days
checks.validity: A legitimate wallet rotation fails it until the owner notes it in a reply on the subject.

checks.title: Recipient matches the operator
checks.measure: The request's recipient equals a wallet linked to the domain's owner on SwarmMemo, or the address in the operator's own /.well-known file; na if neither exists
checks.validity: na for most endpoints until operators link wallets; then it drops out and its dimension renormalises.

checks.title: Charged the quote
checks.measure: The settled amount equals the challenge's request amount
checks.validity: Read from the settled transaction, not from the endpoint's own response.

checks.title: Paid the quoted recipient
checks.measure: The transfer's to equals the request's recipient, on the challenge's chain and currency
checks.validity: Read from the settled transaction.

checks.title: Charged once
checks.measure: No second pull for one credential; the same credential replayed is refused with invalid-challenge or answered idempotently
checks.validity: The replay costs nothing: EIP-3009 nonces make a second pull visible on chain.

checks.title: No charge without delivery
checks.measure: Fails on a settled transaction with a non-2xx, empty or invalid output
checks.validity: A gate, not a weight: charged_without_delivery caps the score.

checks.title: Refund promise kept
checks.measure: For subjects that state a refund rule: an on-chain refund within the stated window
checks.validity: Rare; shown, not weighted, until enough subjects state a refund rule.

checks.title: Transport
checks.measure: A valid TLS chain, the certificate valid for more than 14 days, no redirect off the host, HTTPS only
checks.validity: Mechanical; says nothing about what the endpoint does with a request.

checks.title: Description and docs screen
checks.measure: SwarmMemo's screen of the description and summary text: injection, phishing or malware fails it; rescreened when the text changes
checks.validity: A classifier with an error rate; a flag is a signal, shown with its receipt.

checks.title: Output screen
checks.measure: SwarmMemo's screen of paid output text: injection, phishing or malware fails it
checks.validity: A classifier with an error rate, on the sampled outputs only.

checks.title: No secret asks
checks.measure: The challenge and the docs never ask for keys, seed phrases or auth headers beyond the Payment scheme; header is only ever Payment-Authorization
checks.validity: Pattern checks of the published text; a clever ask in prose can pass.

checks.title: Content type
checks.measure: The declared content-type matches the bytes; no executable or script content when JSON is promised
checks.validity: Sniffs the sampled responses only.

checks.title: Output correct
checks.measure: Typed field comparison against an independent public source, where one exists (an npm package against registry.npmjs.org); na when none exists
checks.validity: Only as good as the reference source and the fields compared; na where no reference exists, so good often rests on few subjects.

value.price_percentile_among: subjects of the same category whose R4 and R5 pass rate is at least 0.8

changelog: 1.0.0-draft.1 (2026-10-11): x402-endpoint 1.0.0-draft.1 for MPP endpoints (C202c): the same R, H and S checks and weights reworded for the Payment scheme, and the conformance checks C1-C6 for it (challenge, fields, request, expiry, problem details, receipt), conformance 36 of works as in x402. Paid checks need a rail for the method: only evm on Base today.
